verdict.rationale: Airbyte's GitHub and site claim a large catalog of 600-700+ maintained connectors spanning APIs, databases, warehouses, and lakes, backed by community testimonials of real-world use pulling data from 'weird places' and self-hosted production use. Missing for 10: independent verification of connector maintenance quality/freshness at scale and no direct rebuttal to catalog breadth claims beyond isolated setup/deletion-handling complaints.
